sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Amendment Of Certain Laws Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT OF CERTAIN LAWS) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2002
ORDINANCE XLVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend certain laws in their application to the North-West Frontier
Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 29th September, 2002]
No. Legis:1(2)/76/7736/7828,
dated 29-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province (Amendment of Certain Laws) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Amendment Of Certain Laws Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 9 of Act II of 1999

ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT OF CERTAIN LAWS) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2002
ORDINANCE XLVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend certain laws in their application to the North-West Frontier
Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 29th September, 2002]
No. Legis:1(2)/76/7736/7828,
dated 29-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 9 of
Act II of 1999.--In the Stamp Act. 1899 (II of 1999), in its application to
the North-West Frontier Province, in section 9.--
(i) in clause
(c), the full-stop appearing at the end shall be replaced by a semi-colon, and
the word "and": and
(ii) after
clause (c), as so amended, the following new clause (d) shall be added, namely:
"(d) exempt
from payment of duties either in whole or in part respect of the instrument
executed by Al-Shifa Trust, for the transfer of land, donated by Government
free of cost measuring 80 Kanals, for the construction of an Eye Hospital at
Kohat."

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Amendment Of Certain Laws Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 78 of Act No. XVI of 1908

ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT OF CERTAIN LAWS) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2002
ORDINANCE XLVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend certain laws in their application to the North-West Frontier
Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 29th September, 2002]
No. Legis:1(2)/76/7736/7828,
dated 29-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 78 of
Act No. XVI of 1908.--In the Registration Act. 1908 (XVI of 1908), in its
application to the North-West Frontier Province, in section 78, the full-stop
appearing at the end of the second proviso shall be replaced by a colon and
thereafter the following new proviso shall be added namely:
"Provided also that the
Provincial Government may by notification in the official Gazette, exempt from
payment of registration fee either in whole or in part to respect of the
instrument executed by Al-Shifa Trust, for the transfer of land donated by Government
free of cost, measuring 80 Kanals, for the construction of an Eye Hospital at
Kohat."
